Acid Splash.description: Acid Splash is a cantrip (Conjuration). It deals ⁠Acid damage to enemies in a small area.

Activate Witch Bolt.description: Activate Witch Bolt is a cantrip (Evocation). It allows spellcasters to electrocute targets connected by Witch Bolt dealing 1d12⁠⁠Lightning damage.

Blade Ward.description: Blade Ward is a cantrip (Abjuration). It allows spellcasters to become more resilient against physical damage.

Bone Chill.description: Bone Chill is a cantrip (Necromancy). It deals ⁠Necrotic damage and prevents the target from regaining Hit Points.

Booming Blade.description: Booming Blade is a cantrip (Evocation). It allows the caster to strike with their melee weapon, dealing further damage if the target moves afterwards.

Bursting Sinew.description: Bursting Sinew is a cantrip (Necromancy). It allows the caster to detonate a corpse into a small AoE of damage.

Conjure Us.description: Conjure Us is a cantrip (Conjuration). This spell summons Us as a controllable ally.

Dancing Lights.description: Dancing Lights is a cantrip (Evocation). It creates magical orbs of light that brighten an area.

Eldritch Blast.description: Eldritch Blast is a cantrip (Evocation). It allows the spellcaster to shoot out an energy beam that deals ⁠Force damage, and can be upgraded with Warlock abilities.

Fiery Bolt.description: Fiery Bolt is a cantrip (Evocation). It allows the caster to hurl a bolt of ⁠fire at an enemy. It cannot be learned by party members.

Fire Bolt.description: Fire Bolt is a cantrip (Evocation). It allows the caster to hurl a bolt of fire at an enemy.

Firebolt?.description: Firebolt? is a cantrip (Evocation). It functions the same as the Fire Bolt cantrip, but has a 1/20 chance to cause a Fireball explosion.

Friends.description: Friends is a cantrip (Enchantment). It makes the caster appear more charismatic to the affected creature.

Guidance.description: Guidance is a cantrip (Divination). This cantrip allows spellcasters to grant a temporary bonus to a creature's ability checks.

Light.description: Light is a cantrip (Evocation). It makes an object shed light in a small area.

Mage Hand.description: Mage Hand is a cantrip (Conjuration). It conjures a spectral hand that can interact with objects.

Minor Illusion.description: Minor Illusion is a cantrip (Illusion). It conjures a simple illusion to distract and / or lure creatures.

Moonmote.description: Moonmote is a cantrip (Evocation). It is granted by the Selûne's Spear of Night. This ability decreases enemy movement around you and gives you and your allies extra ⁠Radiant damage.

Poison Spray.description: Poison Spray is a cantrip (Conjuration). It allows spellcasters to deal ⁠Poison damage to a target.

Produce Flame.description: Produce Flame is a cantrip (Conjuration). It creates a blue flame in the caster's palm which emanates light and can be thrown at enemies.

Psychic Rend.description: Psychic Rend is a cantrip (Enchantment). This potent cantrip wielded by githyanki ardents pierces the very thoughts of their opponents. It cannot be learned by party members.

Ray of Frost.description: Ray of Frost is a cantrip (Evocation). It deals ⁠Cold damage to the target and slows it down.

Reach from Beyond.description: Reach from Beyond is a cantrip (Necromancy). It is used by Necromites and Death Shepherds and deals necrotic damage to a single target. It cannot be learned by party members.

Resistance.description: Resistance is a cantrip (Abjuration). It grants a temporary bonus to a creature's Saving Throws.

Sacred Flame.description: Sacred Flame is a cantrip (Evocation). It deals Radiant damage to a target.

Shocking Grasp.description: Shocking Grasp is a cantrip (Evocation). It makes a melee attack that inflicts ⁠Lightning damage and prevents the target from taking a Reaction.

Thaumaturgy.description: Thaumaturgy is a cantrip (Transmutation). It temporarily improves the caster's Intimidation and Performance checks.

Thorn Whip.description: Thorn Whip is a cantrip (Transmutation). It deals damage to a target and pulls it closer to the caster.

Toll the Dead.description: Toll the Dead is a cantrip (Necromancy). It deals ⁠Necrotic damage and increases in damage if the target has already been damaged.[See: Bugs]

True Strike.description: True Strike is a cantrip (Divination). It gives the caster Advantage on their next Attack Roll against the target.

Veil of the Weird.description: Veil of the Weird is a cantrip (Illusion). It is an unique spell only available during the Confront the Elder Brain quest which allows the caster to apply Greater Invisibility on up to five creatures.

Vicious Mockery.description: Vicious Mockery is a cantrip (Enchantment). It deals Psychic damage to enemies and inflicts Disadvantage on their Attack Rolls.

Curse of Terror.description: Curse of Terror is a cantrip (Enchantment). This spell deals damage and frightens a single target. It cannot be learned by party members.

Improved Minor Illusion.description: Improved Minor Illusion is a cantrip (Illusion). It is an upgraded version of Minor Illusion available to Illusion School wizards which only costs a Bonus Action.

Shillelagh.description: Shillelagh is a cantrip (Transmutation). It imbues the caster's weapon with nature power.

Sorrowful Lash.description: Sorrowful Lash is a cantrip (Transmutation). It deals damage to a target and pulls it closer to the caster. It is essentially equivalent to the Thorn Whip cantrip except it uses a Bonus Action and base damage does not scale with level.

Strengthened Shillelagh.description: Strengthened Shillelagh is a cantrip (Transmutation). It imbues the caster's weapon with nature power. It cannot be learned by party members.

Activate Call Lightning.description: Activate Call Lightning is a level 3 conjuration spell. This spell allows spellcasters to call down lightning again to hit all targets within the area of effect. It can only be obtained while concentrating on Call Lightning.

Aid.description: Aid is a level 2 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to heal and embolden their allies and themselves with resolve. Affected creatures have their maximum Hit Points increased for the duration of the spell.

Animal Friendship.description: Animal Friendship is a level 1 enchantment spell. It charms a beast, convincing it that the caster means no harm.

Animate Dead.description: Animate Dead is a level 3 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to animate a corpse to create an undead servant.

Arcane Gate.description: Arcane Gate is a level 6 conjuration spell. It creates two connected portals which allow creatures to freely teleport between them.

Arcane Lock.description: Arcane Lock is a level 2 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to magically lock a container.

Armour of Agathys.description: Armour of Agathys is a level 1 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to create a spectral armour of frost that covers the caster and their equipment. This armour provides additional Hit Points to the caster and damages hostile targets while the added hit points are present.

Arms of Hadar.description: Arms of Hadar is a level 1 conjuration spell. It allows the caster to summon dark tendrils and deal ⁠Necrotic damage to creatures in an area centered on the caster, preventing them from taking Reactions.

Astral Rift.description: Astral Rift is a level 3 conjuration spell. This spell is used by some NPC githyanki casters to summon additional allies. It cannot be learned by party members.

Bane.description: Bane is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows the caster to temporarily curse enemies, making their attacks miss more often and weakening their Saving Throws.

Banishing Smite.description: Banishing Smite is a level 5 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to imbue their weapon with power, dealing force damage and possibly Banishing the target.

Banishment.description: Banishment is a level 4 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to temporarily send a target to another plane of existence.

Barkskin.description: Barkskin is a level 2 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to fortify the defense of a willing creature and increase their Armour Class. While under the effect of this spell, the target's skin has a bark-like texture.

Beacon of Hope.description: Beacon of Hope is a level 3 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to bolster their allies with hope and vitality.

Bear's Endurance.description: Bear's Endurance is a level 2 transmutation spell. This spell allows spellcasters to bestow a creature the fortitude of a bear. Affected creatures gain Temporary Hit Points and Advantage on Constitution Checks.

Bestow Curse.description: Bestow Curse is a level 3 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to curse a target with their touch.

Blade Barrier.description: Blade Barrier is a level 6 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to summon a wall of cutting blades.

Bless.description: Bless is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to temporarily bolster themselves and their allies’ attacks and saving throws.

Blight.description: Blight is a level 4 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to drain the moisture and vitality from a target creature using necromantic energy. It is especially effective versus plants.

Blinding Smite.description: Blinding Smite is a level 3 evocation spell. It allows a Paladin to expend a Spell Slot to deal additional ⁠Radiant damage with a melee weapon attack and possibly blind their target.

Blindness.description: Blindness is a level 2 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to magically Blind a targeted hostile creature.

Blink.description: Blink is a level 3 transmutation spell. It allows the spellcaster to travel to the Ethereal Plane, unassailable and unseen until they return.

Blur.description: Blur is a level 2 illusion spell. It blurs the spellcaster's body, making them harder to hit.

Bolts of Doom.description: Bolts of Doom is a level 4 evocation spell. It is a variant of Kereska's Favour that allows its caster to imbue themselves with the power of lightning and unlock resistances and spells associated with it. It is granted by Markoheshkir.

Bone-shaking Thunder.description: Bone-shaking Thunder is a level 4 evocation spell. It is a variant of Kereska's Favour that allows its caster to imbue themselves with the power of thunder and unlock resistances and spells associated with it. It is granted by Markoheshkir.

Boon of Servitude.description: Boon of Servitude is a level 1 evocation spell. This spell increases the Armour Class of its target by 2, and heals it each turn for the duration of the effect. It cannot be learned by party members.

Branding Smite.description: Branding Smite is a level 2 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to cause their weapon to gleam with astral radiance, allowing them to mark targets with light, preventing them from turning Invisible.

Bull's Strength.description: Bull's Strength is a level 2 transmutation spell. This spell allows spellcasters to bestow a creature the might of a bull. Affected creatures have their Carrying Capacity doubled and gain Advantage on Strength Checks.

Burning Hands.description: Burning Hands is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to shoot a flaming cone from their fingertips and deal ⁠Fire damage to enemies.

Call Lightning.description: Call Lightning is a level 3 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to call down lightning to hit all targets within the area of effect. The spellcaster can also call down lightning repeatedly on subsequent turns.

Calm Emotions.description: Calm Emotions is a level 2 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to magically subdue intense emotions in targeted creatures. The affected target becomes neutral to the creatures it was hostile toward. It also cannot be Charmed or Frightened during the duration of the spell.

Careful What You Wish For.description: Careful What You Wish For is a level 4 transmutation spell. This spell allows Akabi to transform a player into a cheese wheel. It cannot be learned by party members.

Carrion's Explosive Cloudkill.description: Carrion's Explosive Cloudkill is a level 5 necromancy spell. This spell allows spellcasters to cause an undead corpse to explode, dealing Poison damage to all creatures nearby. It cannot be learned by party members.

Cat's Grace.description: Cat's Grace is a level 2 transmutation spell. This spell allows spellcasters to bestow a creature the finesse of a cat. Affected creatures gain Resistance to falling damage and gain Advantage on Dexterity Checks.

Celestial Haste.description: Celestial Haste is a level 3 transmutation spell. Provided by equipping Gontr Mael, it allows the wielder to Hasten themselves for 5 turns without suffering the Lethargic condition when it ends.

Chain Lightning.description: Chain Lightning is a level 6 evocation spell. It allows casters to create a bolt of lightning which strikes a target and chains to nearby enemies.

Charm Person.description: Charm Person is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to temporarily charm a humanoid creature, granting Advantage on Charisma Checks.

Cheesy Smell.description: Cheesy Smell is a level 3 conjuration spell. This action allows a polymorphed cheese wheel to create a nauseating cloud of gas that can prevent creatures from taking actions. Targets must make Constitution Saving Throws every turn while they're in the area of effect or become Nauseous.

Chromatic Orb.description: Chromatic Orb is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to fire a ball of energy and deal the chosen damage type to enemies.

Circle of Death.description: Circle of Death is a level 6 necromancy spell. It devastates all creatures within a large radius with ⁠Necrotic energy.

Cloud of Daggers.description: Cloud of Daggers is a level 2 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure a barrage of daggers in an area which deals Slashing damage to any creature entering or starting its turn in the area.

Cloudkill.description: Cloudkill is a level 5 conjuration spell. It conjures a moveable cloud which damages and obscures everything it envelops.

Colour Spray.description: Colour Spray is a level 1 illusion spell. It allows spellcasters to temporarily blind enemies with flashing coloured light, making their attacks miss more often and shortening their attack range.

Command.description: Command is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to order their target to flee, move closer, freeze, drop to the ground, or drop their weapon.

Cone of Cold.description: Cone of Cold is a level 5 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to blast icy air into a region in front of them, damaging affected creatures and turning existing Water surfaces into Ice Surfaces.

Confusion.description: Confusion is a level 4 enchantment spell. It allows the caster to confuse a group of creatures, drastically reducing their effectiveness in combat.

Conjure Barrage.description: Conjure Barrage is a level 3 conjuration spell. It allows rangers to use one of their weapons to strike everyone within a wide cone with a barrage of magical blades.

Conjure Elemental.description: Conjure Elemental is a level 5 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to summon a Fire, Earth, Water, or Air Elemental.

Conjure Minor Elemental.description: Conjure Minor Elemental is a level 4 conjuration spell. It conjures 2 Mud Mephits, 2 Ice Mephits, or an Azer to fight for you.

Conjure Shadow Lantern Wraith.description: Conjure Shadow Lantern Wraith is a level 6 necromancy spell. Summon a Shadow to fight by your side.

Conjure Woodland Being.description: Conjure Woodland Being is a level 4 conjuration spell. It summons a Dryad to fight alongside the caster.

Contagion.description: Contagion is a level 5 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to infect their target with an affliction of their choosing, potentially resulting in the target contracting a disease.

Create or Destroy Water.description: Create or Destroy Water is a level 1 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure or destroy an area of water (or water-like surfaces).

Create Undead.description: Create Undead is a level 6 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to animate a corpse, creating an undead servant.

Create Water.description: Create Water is a level 1 transmutation spell. This spell is a variant of Create or Destroy Water that allows spellcasters to conjure an area of water that rain from thin air and forms a water surface. Creatures standing in the area when the spell is cast will become Wet.

Crown of Madness.description: Crown of Madness is a level 2 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to temporarily charm a humanoid creature and induce madness in their mind. The affected creature then makes a melee attack against any creature aside from the caster within its reach.

Crusader's Mantle.description: Crusader's Mantle is a level 3 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to imbue their allies' weapons with holy power, causing them to deal additional Radiant damage.

Cure Wounds.description: Cure Wounds is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to heal allies with divine magic through touch.

Curse of Regret.description: Curse of Regret is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell applies the Curse of Regret debuff on a target, applying Psychic vulnerability and dealing Psychic damage each turn. It cannot be learned by party members.

Danse Macabre.description: Danse Macabre is a level 5 necromancy spell. It summons 4 uncontrollable Ghouls to fight for you.

Darkness.description: Darkness is a level 2 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure a cloud of darkness in an area within range which obscures and inflicts Blindness to those within it.

Darkvision.description: Darkvision is a level 2 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to alter a creature's sight, granting them the ability to see in the dark.

Daylight.description: Daylight is a level 3 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to dispel darkness by summoning a sphere of light or enchanting an item to shine like the sun.

Deadlier than Arsenic.description: Deadlier than Arsenic is a level 4 evocation spell. It is a variant of Kereska's Favour that allows its caster to imbue themselves with the power of poison and unlock resistances and spells associated with it. It is granted by Markoheshkir.

Death Ward.description: Death Ward is a level 4 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to prevent a target from dying.

Destroy Water.description: Destroy Water is a level 1 transmutation spell. This spell is a variant of Create or Destroy Water that allows spellcasters to destroy an area of water (or water-like surfaces). The spell will remove the Wet condition from creatures within its area of effect.

Destructive Wave.description: Destructive Wave is a level 5 evocation spell. It allows the caster to create a massive shockwave that damages enemies and can possibly knock them prone.

Detect Thoughts.description: Detect Thoughts is a level 2 divination spell. It allows spellcasters to telepathically link to unprotected minds and hear the thoughts of targeted creatures while talking to them.

Dethrone.description: Dethrone is a level 5 necromancy spell. It is a unique spell which deals a devastating amount of ⁠Necrotic damage to a single target. Only wizards can learn this spell by transcribing it from a unique scroll.

Diabolic Chains.description: Diabolic Chains is a level 6 evocation spell. This spell is available only to Raphael, deals Hellfire damage and pushes back targets 5m. It cannot be learned by party members.

Dimension Door.description: Dimension Door is a level 4 conjuration spell. It teleports the caster and an ally.

Disguise Self.description: Disguise Self is a level 1 illusion spell. It allows spellcasters to temporarily change their appearance. While active, gain access to the action Dispel Disguise to end the effect.

Disintegrate.description: Disintegrate is a level 6 transmutation spell. It allows casters to deal devastating ⁠Force damage to a single target, possibly destroying it completely.

Dissonant Whispers.description: Dissonant Whispers is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to fill a target with terror and deal ⁠Psychic damage to them.

Divine Revelry.description: Divine Revelry is a level 9 enchantment spell. It allows Gale to create a firewine barrel and force several creatures to dance in place.

Dominate Beast.description: Dominate Beast is a level 4 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to temporarily charm a Beast into fighting alongside the caster, rather than against them.

Dominate Person.description: Dominate Person is a level 5 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to force a humanoid to temporarily fight as an ally.

Draconic Elemental Weapon.description:
Draconic Elemental Weapon is a level 3 transmutation spell. It imbues a weapon with a chosen energy type, increasing its damage and accuracy.
This item spell is similar to the Paladin spell Elemental Weapon.

Drunken Inhale.description: Drunken Inhale is a level 1 evocation spell. This spell allows spellcasters to damage and intoxicate creatures in an area in front of them. It cannot be learned by party members.

Eagle's Splendour.description: Eagle's Splendour is a level 2 transmutation spell. This spell allows spellcasters to bestow a creature the elegance of an eagle. Affected creatures gain Advantage on Charisma Checks.

Elemental Weapon.description: Elemental Weapon is a level 3 transmutation spell. It imbues a weapon with a chosen energy type, increasing its damage and accuracy.

Enhance Ability.description: Enhance Ability is a level 2 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to strengthen an aspect of a creature's physical or mental attributes.

Enhance Leap.description: Enhance Leap is a level 1 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to increase a creature's Jumping distance.

Enlarge.description: Enlarge is a level 2 transmutation spell. This spell allows spellcasters to increase a creature's body size. Affected creatures deal more damage with their weapons and gain Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws.

Enlarge/Reduce.description: Enlarge/Reduce is a level 2 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to alter a creature's body size. The caster can choose to double or halve the size of the affected creature.

Ensnaring Strands.description: Ensnaring Strands is a level 1 conjuration spell. It is an item spell similar to Ensnaring Strike which can be cast while wielding Cruel Sting.

Ensnaring Strike.description: Ensnaring Strike is a level 1 conjuration spell. This spell allows spellcasters to use weapon attacks to ensnare enemies with thorny vines and deal ⁠Piercing damage to them each turn.

Entangle.description: Entangle is a level 1 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure magical vines and turn an area within range into difficult terrain. Creatures are possibly Entangled and move at half speed while standing in this area.

Enthrall.description: Enthrall is a level 2 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to capture the attention of a creature, forcing it to focus on them.

Evard's Black Tentacles.description: Evard's Black Tentacles is a level 4 conjuration spell. It summons tentacles in an area that make it difficult to move and harm creatures.

Exhort the Risen.description: Exhort the Risen is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows the caster to command the undead, similar to the spell Command.

Eyebite.description: Eyebite is a level 6 necromancy spell. It allows casters to choose amongst one of three debilitating conditions to impose on a single target.

Faerie Fire.description: Faerie Fire is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure brilliant light. Any creature caught in the radius temporarily sheds faint light and prevents Invisibility.

Faithwarden's Vines.description: Faithwarden's Vines is a level 1 conjuration spell. This spell allows spellcasters to conjure magical vines and turn an area within range into difficult terrain. Creatures are possibly Entangled and move at half speed while standing in this area. It is equivalent in effect to the Druid's Level 1 Spell Entangle.

False Life.description: False Life is a level 1 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to gain Temporary Hit Points.

Fear.description: Fear is a level 3 illusion spell. It allows spellcasters to terrify targets by projecting phantasmal images, forcing enemies to flee.

Feign Death.description: Feign Death is a level 3 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to put their allies into a magical, protective coma, feigning death.

Fiendish Charm.description: Fiendish Charm is a level 1 enchantment spell. Fiendish Charm is a class action available to Cambions. It allows the user to charm a humanoid enemy, prevented it from attacking the user. It cannot be learned by party members.

Find Familiar.description: Find Familiar is a level 1 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure a fey familiar that can aid them in combat and world exploration.

Finger of Death.description: Finger of Death is a level 7 necromancy spell. It is only available to Apostle of Myrkul after it consumes a Necromite and has the condition Reaper's Reward. It cannot be learned by party members.

Fire Shield.description: Fire Shield is a level 4 evocation spell. It shields the spellcaster with luminous energy.

Fireball.description: Fireball is a level 3 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to unleash a streak of fire from their hands which ignites into a large explosion at a chosen point within range.

Flame of Wrath.description: Flame of Wrath is a level 4 evocation spell. It is a variant of Kereska's Favour that allows its caster to imbue themselves with the power of fire and unlock resistances and spells associated with it. It is granted by Markoheshkir.

Flame Strike.description: Flame Strike is a level 5 evocation spell. It allows the caster to make a pillar of divine flame at a chosen location dealing 5d6⁠⁠Fire damage and 5d6⁠⁠Radiant damage.

Flames of Avernus.description: Flames of Avernus is a level 6 evocation spell. It allows Raphael to consume a soul to shoot a flaming cone. It cannot be learned by party members.

Flaming Sphere.description: Flaming Sphere is a level 2 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure a Flaming Sphere which can attack and burn enemies.

Flesh to Gold.description: Flesh to Gold is a level 6 transmutation spell. It restrains a target and turns it into gold after 3 turns.

Flesh to Stone.description: Flesh to Stone is a level 6 transmutation spell. It allows the caster to Atrophy a foe, Restraining them until they temporarily turn to stone.

Fog Cloud.description: Fog Cloud is a level 1 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to summon a sphere of Fog on an area in range and heavily obscure the area. Creatures within the area are Blinded.

Fox's Cunning.description: Fox's Cunning is a level 2 transmutation spell. This spell allows spellcasters to bestow a creature the slyness of a fox. Affected creatures gain Advantage on Intelligence Checks.

Freedom of Movement.description: Freedom of Movement is a level 4 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to imbue an ally with the ability to avoid some slowing effects.

Frost of Dark Winter.description: Frost of Dark Winter is a level 4 evocation spell. It is a variant of Kereska's Favour that allows its caster to imbue themselves with the power of ice and unlock resistances and spells associated with it. It is granted by Markoheshkir.

Gaseous Form.description: Gaseous Form is a level 3 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to transform themselves or an ally into a cloud of mist to avoid attacks, reduce size, and gain Advantage on some Saving Throws.

Ghoulish Touch.description: Ghoulish Touch is a level 1 necromancy spell. This spell is only found granted by Ring of Exalted Marrow. It allows the user to attack a target and possibly Paralyse them.

Globe of Invulnerability.description: Globe of Invulnerability is a level 6 abjuration spell.

Glyph of Warding.description: Glyph of Warding is a level 3 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to inscribe a ward that can trigger various magical effects when stepped on by an enemy.

Goodberry.description: Goodberry is a level 1 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to create magical berries which have healing properties when eaten.

Grant Flight.description: Grant Flight is a level 3 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to grant a creature they touch the ability to fly.

Grease.description: Grease is a level 1 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure flammable Grease on the ground within range and turn it into Difficult Terrain.

Greater Invisibility.description: Greater Invisibility is a level 4 illusion spell. It allows spellcasters to provide a more resilient form of Invisibility for their allies.

Greater Restoration.description: Greater Restoration is a level 5 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to removes any kind of charm, petrification, stun, or curse effect from a creature.

Guardian of Faith.description: Guardian of Faith is a level 4 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to summon a divine guardian which sacrifices its Hit Points to damage enemies.

Guiding Bolt.description: Guiding Bolt is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to hit enemies with radiant bolt that deals ⁠Radiant damage and grants advantage to the next attack roll made against them.

Gust of Wind.description: Gust of Wind is a level 2 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure a squall to clear dangerous gasses or throw creatures back, potentially causing a dangerous fall.

Hail of Thorns.description: Hail of Thorns is a level 1 conjuration spell. It allows the caster to make a ranged attack which creates a ⁠Piercing damage explosion in addition to dealing normal weapon damage.

Harm.description: Harm is a level 6 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to make an enemy much more feeble.

Haste.description: Haste is a level 3 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to allow their allies to become Hastened.

Heal.description: Heal is a level 6 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to substantially heal a target by recovering Hit Points and removing Diseases.

Heat Metal.description: Heat Metal is a level 2 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to heat up a metal weapon or armour on the targeted creature, forcing them to let go or receive damage or suffer various penalties.

Hellfire Orb.description: Hellfire Orb is a level 6 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to unleash a streak of fire from their hands that ignites into a large explosion at a chosen point within range. It cannot be learned by party members.

Heroes' Feast.description: Heroes' Feast is a level 6 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to summon a bountiful smorgasbord to bolster themselves and their allies and strengthen their resolve.

Heroism.description: Heroism is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to instill courage in themselves or an ally; the affected creature cannot be frightened and gains temporary hit points.

Hold Monster.description: Hold Monster is a level 5 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to Paralyse a creature, preventing them from acting and making them vulnerable to attacks.

Hold Person.description: Hold Person is a level 2 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to hold a target humanoid in place. The affected creature is unable to move or act and is more susceptible to attacks.

Hordestrike.description: Hordestrike is a level 4 evocation spell. It is cast as a legendary reaction available to Ketheric in Honour mode. It cannot be learned by party members.

Hunger of Hadar.description: Hunger of Hadar is a level 3 conjuration spell. It creates an area that deals damage and inflicts conditions to creatures in it, including reduced movement speed.

Hypnotic Pattern.description: Hypnotic Pattern is a level 3 illusion spell. It allows spellcasters to hypnotise all creatures within an area.

Ice Knife.description: Ice Knife is a level 1 conjuration spell. It allows the caster to throw a shard of ice, which explodes and leaves behind an icy surface.

Ice Storm.description: Ice Storm is a level 4 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to summon an ice storm to strike an area.

Igniting Spark.description: Igniting Spark is a level 4 evocation spell. This spell is available only to Raphael, and deals fire damage and creates a Hellfire surface for one turn. It can also be used as a Bonus Action when expending a soul charge. It cannot be learned by party members.

Incinerate.description: Incinerate is a level 6 evocation spell. It is a unique spell to Raphael, requiring two Soul Charges and dealing 8d8⁠⁠Fire damage. It cannot be learned by party members.

Inflict Wounds.description: Inflict Wounds is a level 1 necromancy spell. It allows the spellcaster to make a melee attack which inflicts Necrotic damage.

Insect Plague.description: Insect Plague is a level 5 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to create a damaging, debilitating swarm of insects over a section of the battlefield.

Invigorating Flame.description: Invigorating Flame is a level 4 conjuration spell. This spell allows Aelis Siryasius to revive grease elementals as lava elementals and grease mephits as magma mephits. It cannot be learned by party members.

Invisibility.description: Invisibility is a level 2 illusion spell. It allows spellcasters to turn themselves and other creatures Invisible to the naked eye.

Karsite Grip.description: Karsite Grip is a level 6 evocation spell. This spell, cast once per round by the Crown of Karsus on Honour Mode, fires a deadly and disoriented force beam between up to four targets. It cannot be learned by party members.

Karsus' Compulsion.description: Karsus' Compulsion is a level 9 enchantment spell. It is granted by the Triune Netherstone and is usable only by Full-Illithids to control the Crown of Karsus.

Kereska's Favour.description: Kereska's Favour is a level 4 evocation spell. Granted by Markoheshkir, it allows its caster to imbue themselves with an element and unlock resistances and spells associated with it.

Knock.description: Knock is a level 2 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to unlock non-magical locks.

Lesser Restoration.description: Lesser Restoration is a level 2 abjuration spell. It allows the spellcaster to cure an adjacent creature.

Lightning Arrow.description: Lightning Arrow is a level 3 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to fire an arrow of electricity that bursts on impact, dealing additional Lightning damage to creatures in the vicinity.

Lightning Bolt.description: Lightning Bolt is a level 3 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to discharge a bolt of lightning in any direction, potentially hitting multiple creatures.

Longstrider.description: Longstrider is a level 1 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to make a creature move farther during a turn.

Lunar Bulwark.description: Lunar Bulwark is a level 1 abjuration spell. It is granted by the Moon Devotion Robe, which allows the wearer cast the functional equivalent of Mage Armour on themselves once per long rest.[See: Bugs]

Lunar Flare.description: Lunar Flare is a level 2 evocation spell. This spell is available to Dame Aylin, and hits enemies with radiant bolt that deals ⁠Radiant damage, Holy Fire, and grants Advantage to Attack Roll made against them.

Lunar Smite.description: Lunar Smite is a level 1 evocation spell. It is only available to Dame Aylin and the Moonlight Slivers, which deals radiant damage on-top of weapon damage, and inflicts Holy Fire. It cannot be learned by party members.

Mage Armour.description: Mage Armour is a level 1 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to surround an unarmoured creature (including themselves, if unarmoured) with magical protection.

Magic Missile.description: Magic Missile is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to hit enemies with multiple projectiles that deal ⁠Force damage.

Magic Weapon.description: Magic Weapon is a level 2 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to infuse a weapon with arcane energy, making it magical.

Mass Cure Wounds.description: Mass Cure Wounds is a level 5 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to heal several of their allies.

Melf's Acid Arrow.description: Melf's Acid Arrow is a level 2 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to shoot a magical arrow that deals Acid damage to a target on impact and at the end of its next turn.

Mind Flayer Domination.description: Mind Flayer Domination is a level 4 enchantment spell. This spell allows mind flayers to dominate a nearby humanoid.

Mind Mastery.description: Mind Mastery is a level 3 enchantment spell. It forces a creature to make an attack against an ally. It cannot be learned by party members.

Mind Spike.description: Mind Spike is a level 1 enchantment spell. It cannot be learned by party members.

Mirror Image.description: Mirror Image is a level 2 illusion spell. It allows spellcasters to create 3 illusory duplicates of themselves to distract attackers.

Moonbeam.description: Moonbeam is a level 2 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to call down a beam of moonlight which deals Radiant damage to any creature that enters the beam or starts its turn there.

Move Moonbeam.description: Move Moonbeam is a level 2 evocation spell. This spell allows spellcasters to move their Moonbeam to a different location, damaging creatures that enter it.

Murderous Cloud of Daggers.description: Murderous Cloud of Daggers is a level 2 conjuration spell. This spell is a unique variant of Cloud of Daggers used by Invokers of Bhaal. It allows spellcasters to conjure a barrage of daggers in an area that deals piercing damage to any creature entering or starting its turn in the area. It cannot be learned by party members.

Obliging Assistant.description: Obliging Assistant is a level 4 necromancy spell. This spell allows Malus Thorm's undead nurses to heal him. It cannot be learned by party members.

Otiluke's Conveniently Portable Freezing.description: Otiluke's Conveniently Portable Freezing Sphere is a level 6 evocation spell.

Otiluke's Freezing Sphere.description: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere is a level 6 evocation spell.

Otiluke's Resilient Sphere.description: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere is a level 4 evocation spell. It surrounds a target in an impenetrable protective sphere which blocks everything from coming in or out of the sphere. The encased creature is rendered completely invulnerable to outside attacks or spells, but conversely is blocked from attacking or targeting anything outside the sphere.

Otto's Irresistible Dance.description: Otto's Irresistible Dance is a level 6 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to force a creature to stay in place, inactive.

Owl's Wisdom.description: Owl's Wisdom is a level 2 transmutation spell. This spell allows spellcasters to bestow a creature the intuition of an owl. Affected creatures gain Advantage on Wisdom Checks.

Paralyzing Ray.description: Paralyzing Ray is a level 3 necromancy spell. It paralyses its target.

Pass Without Trace.description: Pass Without Trace is a level 2 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to grant themselves and nearby allies a bonus to Stealth Checks.

Phantasmal Force.description: Phantasmal Force is a level 2 illusion spell. It allows spellcasters to flood a target creature's mind with an illusion of the last thing that attacked it, dealing 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage per turn, changing to the last type of damage inflicted upon the target.

Phantasmal Killer.description: Phantasmal Killer is a level 4 illusion spell. It allows spellcasters to temporarily haunt a creatures mind with illusions, dealing damage, preventing movement, and imposing Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls.

Planar Ally.description: Planar Ally is a level 6 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to summon an Elemental, Celestial, or Fiend for aid.

Planar Binding.description: Planar Binding is a level 5 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to take control of a Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend.

Plant Growth.description: Plant Growth is a level 3 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to cause an area to expel weeds from the ground, quartering the movement speed of all creatures travelling through the area.

Polymorph.description: Polymorph is a level 4 transmutation spell. It transforms a creature into a sheep.

Possession.description: Possession is a level 5 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to possess a creature, forcing it to do their bidding and dealing ⁠Necrotic damage every turn. It cannot be learned by party members.

Power Word Kill.description: Power Word Kill is a level 9 enchantment spell. It kills an enemy, and can only be used once per campaign.

Prayer of Healing.description: Prayer of Healing is a level 2 evocation spell. It allows clerics to heal all allies outside of combat.

Protection from Energy.description: Protection from Energy is a level 3 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to grant a creature they touch Resistance to an element of their choice.

Protection from Evil and Good.description: Protection from Evil and Good is a level 1 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to surround themselves with magical protection against Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead.

Protection from Missiles.description: Protection from Missiles is a level 2 abjuration spell. It protects the caster against ranged weapon attacks for up to 10 turns.

Protection from Poison.description: Protection from Poison is a level 2 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to grant the creature they touch protection from Poison and poisonous effects.

Ravaging Inferno.description: Ravaging Inferno is a level 6 evocation spell. This spell is available only to Raphael, deals fire damage and creates a Hellfire Surface for one turn. It cannot be learned by party members.

Ray of Enfeeblement.description: Ray of Enfeeblement is a level 2 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to make a ranged spell attack against a creature and sap their Strength. A weakened creature deals half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength.

Ray of Fear.description: Ray of Fear is a level 3 necromancy spell. It is a unique spell which frightens its target and can be used by equipping the amulet The Spectator Eyes.

Ray of Sickness.description: Ray of Sickness is a level 1 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to hit enemies with a ray of nauseating energy that deals ⁠Poison damage, and potentially Poisons them.

Rays of Fire.description: Rays of Fire is a level 2 evocation spell. This spell allows cambions to hurl 3 rays of fire at targets within range. The rays can all target the same creature, or they can be dispersed to different targets. It cannot be learned by party members.

Recast Speak with Dead.description: Recast Speak with Dead is a level 3 necromancy spell. This ability allows spellcasters to recast Speak with Dead without consuming a spell slot.

Recast Sunbeam.description: Recast Sunbeam is a level 6 evocation spell. This spell allows spellcasters to project a beam of light, Blinding and dealing Radiant damage to everything in its path. It can then be recast on subsequent turns without expending a Spell Slot.

Reduce.description: Reduce is a level 2 transmutation spell. This spell allows spellcasters to decrease a creature's body size. Affected creatures deal less damage with their weapons and have Disadvantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws.

Remove Curse.description: Remove Curse is a level 3 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to remove all curses afflicting a target by touch.

Revivify.description: Revivify is a level 3 necromancy spell. It allows the spellcaster to bring a Companion with 0 hit points back to life.

Revoke Guest Status.description: Revoke Guest Status is a level 5 abjuration spell. It is a unique version of Banishment available to Hope which can permanently banish an enemy from House of Hope. It cannot be learned by party members.

Ride the Winds.description: Ride the Winds is a level 3 transmutation spell. It can be cast when wearing the Amulet of Windrider and transforms the wearer into a small cloud of mist. It is equivalent to Gaseous Form except it can only affect the caster.

Scorching Ray.description: Scorching Ray is a level 2 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to hurl 3 rays of fire at one or more targets within range. Each ray has a separate Attack Roll and deals Fire damage.

Searing Smite.description: Searing Smite is a level 1 evocation spell. It causes the spellcaster's melee weapon to flare with white-hot intensity, searing their targets on hit.

See Invisibility.description: See Invisibility is a level 2 divination spell. It allows spellcasters to see Invisible objects and creatures within range while not Incapacitated. Creatures within range which fail a Dexterity Saving Throw lose their invisibility.

Seeming.description: Seeming is a level 5 illusion spell. It allows spellcasters to disguise their allies.

Shatter.description: Shatter is a level 2 evocation spell. It allows the spellcaster to generate a deafening noise explosion that can damage multiple creatures and objects. This spell is especially potent against inorganic targets, which must make their Saving Throw at Disadvantage.

Silence.description: Silence is a level 2 illusion spell. It allows spellcasters to summon a sphere of absolute quiet in an area within range. Creatures within this sphere are immune to ⁠Thunder damage and cannot cast verbal spells.

Sizzling Cataclysm.description: Sizzling Cataclysm is a level 4 evocation spell. It is a variant of Kereska's Favour that allows its caster to imbue themselves with the power of acid and unlock resistances and spells associated with it. It is granted by Markoheshkir.

Sleep.description: Sleep is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows the spellcaster to temporarily make conscious creatures fall into a deep slumber.

Sleet Storm.description: Sleet Storm is a level 3 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to call forth a storm that douses fire, creates an icy surface, and disrupts the concentration of spellcasters.

Slow.description: Slow is a level 3 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to reduce movement speed, Armour Class, and Dexterity Saving Throws, and also limit actions.

Speak with Animals.description: Speak with Animals is a level 1 divination spell. It allows spellcasters to understand and talk to beasts until they long rest.

Speak with Dead.description: Speak with Dead is a level 3 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to grant a semblance of life to a corpse, allowing it to answer questions.

Spike Growth.description: Spike Growth is a level 2 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to transform an area of land into a hazardous spiky terrain. Creatures walking through the area have their speed halved and take Piercing damage.

Spirit Guardians.description: Spirit Guardians is a level 3 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to call forth spirits to damage nearby targets and slow their Movement.

Staggering Smite.description: Staggering Smite is a level 4 evocation spell. It adds ⁠Psychic damage to the spellcaster's weapon as they strike, possibly staggering the target when hit.

Stinking Cloud.description: Stinking Cloud is a level 3 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to create a nauseating cloud of gas which can prevent creatures from taking actions. Targets must make Constitution Saving Throws every turn while they are in the area of effect or become Nauseous.

Stoneskin.description: Stoneskin is a level 4 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to harden the skin of their ally, granting them Resistance to non-magical physical damage.

Summon Gilded Hellsboar.description: Summon Gilded Hellsboar is a level 1 conjuration spell. It is unique to Helsik, and summons a level 3 Gilded Hellsboar from a corpse. It cannot be learned by party members.

Summon Quothe the Raven.description: Summon Quothe the Raven is a level 3 conjuration spell. It summons the raven Quothe.

Sunbeam.description: Sunbeam is a level 6 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to project a beam of light, Blinding and dealing Radiant damage to everything in its path. They can then use Recast Sunbeam on subsequent turns without expending a Spell Slot.

Tasha's Hideous Laughter.description: Tasha's Hideous Laughter is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to send a targeted creature into a fit of laughter, falling Prone.

Telekinesis.description: Telekinesis is a level 5 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to throw creatures and objects around with only their mind.

Teleport to Submersible.description: Teleport to Submersible is a level 5 conjuration spell. Omeluum can use it to teleport to the Submersible. It cannot be learned by party members.

Thunderous Smite.description: Thunderous Smite is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to cause their melee weapon to ring with ⁠Thunder as they strike, pushing targets away and potentially knocking them Prone.

Thunderwave.description: Thunderwave is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to project out a deafening force that can hit multiple creatures and objects. Creatures hit by this force may be pushed away from the spellcaster.

Untenable Secret.description: Untenable Secret is a level 4 enchantment spell. Forces the target to make a Wisdom Saving Throw or be forced to share a secret. Failure to do so results in taking Necrotic damage. It cannot be learned by party members.

Vampiric Touch.description: Vampiric Touch is a level 3 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters at melee range to siphon the life force of their target.

Wall of Fire.description: Wall of Fire is a level 4 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to create a long, fiery barrier, damaging anything in the area.

Wall of Ice.description: Wall of Ice is a level 6 evocation spell. It creates a wall of ice that deals strong Cold damage to anyone nearby.

Wall of Stone.description: Wall of Stone is a level 5 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to create a solid stone barrier.

Wall of Thorns.description: Wall of Thorns is a level 6 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure a wall of brambles, Entangling and damaging any creatures who are in the area, or trying to pass through.

Warden of Vitality.description: Warden of Vitality is a level 3 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to heal allies repeatedly with Restore Vitality using only bonus actions for 10 turns.

Warding Bond.description: Warding Bond is a level 2 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to bolster an ally's defenses while also sharing any damage they receive.

Web.description: Web is a level 2 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure a mass of sticky and flammable web at an area within range. Creatures moving or entering this area have their speed halved and can become caught in the web.

Whossa Large Fellow?.description: Whossa Large Fellow? is a level 2 transmutation spell. It is granted by Bigboy's Chew Toy, and allows the wielder to enlarge themselves in a manner similar to Enlarge.

Wicked Coercion.description: Wicked Coercion is a level 2 enchantment spell. It is a class action available to Nere that lets him control an enemy by invading their mind. It cannot be learned by party members.

Wind Walk.description: Wind Walk is a level 6 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to transform a group of allies into a cloud of mist. This form offers damage Resistance, Advantage on some Saving Throws, and the ability to Fly.

Witch Bolt.description: Witch Bolt is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to hit enemies with a blue ray of electrifying energy that deals ⁠Lightning damage to them initially and also on subsequent turns.

Withering Gift.description: Withering Gift is a level 4 necromancy spell. This spell allows spellcasters to give their stolen life force to a target of their choosing. It cannot be learned by party members.

Withering Theft.description: Withering Theft is a level 4 necromancy spell. This spell allows spellcasters to siphon the life force of their target. It cannot be learned by party members.

Withering Touch.description: Withering Touch is a level 4 necromancy spell. This spell allows the spellcaster to make a melee attack that inflicts Necrotic damage. It cannot be learned by party members.

Wounding Ray.description: Wounding Ray is a level 3 necromancy spell. It is a spell granted by The Spectator Eyes which allows the user to shoot a deadly necrotic beam.

Wrathful Smite.description: Wrathful Smite is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to channel their wrath through their melee weapon, possibly Frightening their target on hit.

Beckoning Darkness.description: Beckoning Darkness is a level 4 necromancy spell. It curses a creature to take ⁠Necrotic damage if it enters or starts its turn in a Lightly or Heavily Obscured area.

Bludgeon the Weak.description: Bludgeon the Weak is a level 1 transmutation spell. This spell is a variant of Brand the Weak that imposes vulnerability on an enemy to ⁠Bludgeoning damage.

Brand the Weak.description: Brand the Weak is a level 1 transmutation spell. It imposes vulnerability on an enemy to ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Slashing, or ⁠Piercing damage.

Burning Age.description: Burning Age is a level 3 transmutation spell. This spell is a variant of Elemental Age and embodies your Main hand weapon with burning age, granting it bonus Fire damage and a +1 Enchantment.

Call of the Crustacean.description: Call of the Crustacean is a level 3 conjuration spell. This spell summons an Armoured Crab to fight alongside the caster. It cannot be learned by party members.

Castigate Heartform.description: Castigate Heartform is a level 4 illusion spell. This spell curses the target with a specific debuff, personalized according to the form that Viconia "mapped" their heart. It cannot be learned by party members.

Compelled Duel.description: Compelled Duel is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to compel an enemy to ignore other targets and attack only the spellcaster.

Corrosive Age.description: Corrosive Age is a level 3 transmutation spell. This spell is a variant of Elemental Age and embodies your Main hand weapon with corrosive age, granting it bonus Acid damage and a +1 Enchantment.

Disrobing Blinkstep.description: Disrobing Blinkstep is a level 2 conjuration spell. It allows the user to teleport anywhere within sight without triggering Opportunity Attacks, dropping their armor and clothing in the process.

Divine Favour.description: Divine Favour is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to empower their Weapons to deal extra Radiant damage.

Elemental Age.description: Elemental Age is a level 3 transmutation spell. It enhances the caster's main hand weapon with a chosen element, increasing its damage and accuracy.

Expeditious Retreat.description: Expeditious Retreat is a level 1 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to move more swiftly.

Feather Fall.description: Feather Fall is a level 1 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to make themselves and their allies light as a feather, preventing damage when falling from extreme heights.

Flame Blade.description: Flame Blade is a level 2 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to summon a fiery scimitar in their free hand that sheds bright light. Casters can make a melee weapon attack with the blade to deal Fire damage to enemies.

Fleeting Dream.description: Fleeting Dream is a level 2 conjuration spell. This spell allows spellcasters to teleport themselves to an unoccupied space that they can see.

Forced Teleportation.description: Forced Teleportation is a level 5 enchantment spell. This spell lets Cazador teleport one of his vampire spawn to start Black Mass Ritual. It cannot be learned by party members.

Glacial Age.description: Glacial Age is a level 3 transmutation spell. It is a variant of Elemental Age and embodies the caster's Main hand weapon with glacial age, granting it bonus Cold damage and a +1 bonus to attack rolls.

Grasping Vine.description: Grasping Vine is a level 4 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to summon a Grasping Vine which can pull enemies toward itself.

Healing Word.description: Healing Word is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to heal allies that they can see and are within range.

Hex.description: Hex is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to curse a creature and deal additional Necrotic damage to them. The curse also imposes Disadvantage on a chosen ability check.

Hunter's Mark.description: Hunter's Mark is a level 1 divination spell. It allows spellcasters to mark a creature as their prey and deal additional ⁠Weapon damage to the targeted creature.

Infernal Salve.description: Infernal Salve is a level 6 evocation spell. This spell allows Raphael to heal his fellow fiends using a soul. It cannot be learned by party members.

Invocation of Eternal Debt.description: Invocation of Eternal Debt is a level 6 conjuration spell. This spell is available only to Raphael, allowing him to summon an Eternal Debtor. It cannot be learned by party members.

Lovely Assistant.description: Lovely Assistant is a level 5 necromancy spell. When Malus Thorm's assistants are dead, he uses this spell to reanimate them. It cannot be learned by party members.

Luminous Arrow.description: Luminous Arrow is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows a Circle of the Stars druid using Starry Form: Archer to deal radiant damage to a target at a distance.

Mark of Putrefaction.description: Mark of Putrefaction is a level 4 necromancy spell. It makes its target vulnerable to ⁠Necrotic damage. It cannot be learned by party members.

Mass Healing Word.description: Mass Healing Word is a level 3 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to heal several allies that they can see within range.

Misty Step.description: Misty Step is a level 2 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to teleport themselves to an unoccupied space they can see.

No Rest for the Wicked.description: No Rest for the Wicked is a level 3 necromancy spell. This spell, known by Death Shepherds, revives an undead creature. It cannot be learned by party members.

Overwhelming Grief.description: Overwhelming Grief is a level 4 necromancy spell. This spell deals minor necrotic damage upfront and inflicts a curse that causes additional recurring necrotic damage under certain conditions. It cannot be learned by party members.

Pierce the Weak.description: Pierce the Weak is a level 1 transmutation spell. This spell is a variant of Brand the Weak that imposes vulnerability on an enemy to ⁠Piercing damage.

Promise of Wealth.description: Promise of Wealth is a level 6 divination spell. It is unique to Helsik, marking a target and granting them Infectious Greed; it gains an additional 6d6⁠⁠Slashing damage and advantage on attack rolls. It cannot be learned by party members.

Reapply Hunter's Mark.description: Reapply Hunter's Mark is a level 1 divination spell. This spell allows spellcasters to cast Hunter's Mark on other creatures again without using Spell Slots if the previous targets were successfully hunted.

Restore Vitality.description: Restore Vitality is a level 3 evocation spell. It is a situational spell granted upon casting Warden of Vitality that heals the caster or an ally with just the use of a Bonus Action.

Sanctuary.description: Sanctuary is a level 1 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to ward themselves or an ally against enemy attacks.

Shadow Blade.description: Shadow Blade is a level 2 illusion spell. It creates a Shadow Blade in the caster's main hand which deals ⁠Psychic damage.

Share Untenable Secret.description: Share Untenable Secret is a level 4 enchantment spell.

Shield of Faith.description: Shield of Faith is a level 1 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to surround themselves or an ally with divine protection and gain a bonus to their Armour Class.

Shield of Screams.description: Shield of Screams is a level 3 abjuration spell. It is unique to Nere, increasing his Armour Class by 3 and allowing him to retaliate with 2d6⁠⁠Psychic damage against melee attackers. It cannot be learned by party members.

Silvered Bulwark.description: Silvered Bulwark is a level 6 abjuration spell. Moonlight Slivers may use this to place a globe of invulnerability around Dame Aylin, making her Immune to damage. It cannot be learned by party members.

Slash the Weak.description: Slash the Weak is a level 1 transmutation spell. This spell is a variant of Brand the Weak that imposes vulnerability on an enemy to ⁠Slashing damage.

Soul Offering.description: Soul Offering is a level 3 spell. It allows a Gnoll Fang of Yeenoghu to disable a target creature's bonus actions or reactions. It cannot be learned by party members.

Spindleweb Sanctuary.description: Spindleweb Sanctuary is a level 5 abjuration spell. This spell allows spellcasters to ward themselves or an ally against enemy attacks and then damage enemies when it ends. It cannot be learned by party members.

Spiritual Weapon.description: Spiritual Weapon is a level 2 evocation spell. It summons a floating weapon that can attack enemies. The caster can choose between several different weapons, and each has a different weapon action.

The Closed Fist of Bane.description: The Closed Fist of Bane is a level 6 conjuration spell. It allows Gortash to conjure a giant fist that falls to the ground, punching for a great deal of Force damage. It cannot be learned by party members.

Tyr's Protection.description: Tyr's Protection is a level 1 abjuration spell. This spell allows spellcasters to surround themselves or an ally with divine protection and gain a bonus to their Armour Class.

Tyrant's Bindings.description: Tyrant's Bindings is a level 6 conjuration spell. It allows Gortash to restrict the party's movement and deal significant damage to it. It cannot be learned by party members.

Woad's Ensnaring Strike.description: Woad's Ensnaring Strike is a level 1 conjuration spell. This spell allows the wielder of Wood Woad Shield to bash a target with their shield and possibly Ensnare it.

Beguiling Rebuke.description: Beguiling Rebuke is a level 6 enchantment spell. It is a legendary action used by Raphael to charm the creature that attacked him as well as its allies. It cannot be learned by party members.

Counterspell.description: Counterspell is a level 3 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to interrupt another caster's spellcasting, causing it to fail and have no effect.

Elemental Retort.description: Elemental Retort is a level 5 evocation spell. It is unique to Lorroakan, allowing him to retaliate with elemental damage siphoned from his myrmidons when attacked. Each of Lorroakan's myrmidons adds 3d8 damage to to this spell and an additional Reaction to cast it with. It cannot be learned by party members.

Heartwrench.description: Heartwrench is a level 4 illusion spell. It is cast as a legendary reaction available to Viconia DeVir in Honour mode. It cannot be learned by party members.

Hellish Rebuke.description: Hellish Rebuke is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to surround a creature in hellfire that deals ⁠Fire damage as a Reaction when taking damage from them.

Shield.description: Shield is a level 1 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to avoid being hit by an enemy attack at the last possible instant. It also nullifies Magic Missile damage against them.

Soul Ascension.description: Soul Ascension is a level 6 evocation spell. It is available to Raphael while he is in his Ascended Fiend form. It creates an area that, while inside, lets his cambions deal Hellfire damage, and causes Necrotic damage to enemies. It cannot be learned by party members.

The Dead Wastes.description: The Dead Wastes is a level 3 necromancy spell. It is cast as a legendary reaction, and is available to Balthazar in Honour mode. It cannot be learned by party members.

Vampiric Swarm.description: Vampiric Swarm is a level 6 conjuration spell. It is cast as a legendary reaction available to Cazador in Honour mode. It cannot be learned by party members.

Absolute's Talisman: Aid.description: Absolute's Talisman: Aid is a level 2 abjuration spell. This spell allows the Absolute's Talisman's wearer to heal themselves for 5⁠⁠Hit Points and increase their hit points for the same amount.

Animate Dead (Balthazar).description: Animate Dead is a level 6 necromancy spell. This a unique variant of Animate Dead that is cast by Balthazar when fought in Nightsong's Prison. When cast, this spell reanimates the many surrounding piles of bones into an army of skeletons. It cannot be learned by party members.

Animate Dead (Duergar).description: Animate Dead is a level 4 necromancy spell. Gekh Coal uses this spell to animate a pile of corpses at the Underdark Beach. It cannot be learned by party members.

Animate Dead: Flying Ghoul.description: Animate Dead: Flying Ghoul is a level 5 necromancy spell. This spell allows spellcasters to animate a corpse to create a Flying Ghoul. Requires a corpse, and lasts until long rest.

Animate Dead: Flying Ghoul Flock.description: Animate Dead: Flying Ghoul Flock is a level 6 necromancy spell. This spell is a higher level version of Animate Dead: Flying Ghoul that can summon 3 Flying Ghouls instead of 1. Accordingly, the user must also target 3 corpses for this instead of 1.

Animate Dead: Ghoul.description: Animate Dead: Ghoul is a level 5 necromancy spell. This spell allows spellcasters to animate a corpse to create a Ghoul (Animate Dead). Requires a corpse, and lasts until long rest.

Animate Dead: Ghoul Pack.description: Animate Dead: Ghoul Pack is a level 6 necromancy spell. This spell is a higher level version of Animate Dead: Ghoul that can summon 3 Ghouls instead of 1. Accordingly, the user must also target 3 corpses for this instead of 1.

Animate Dead: Skeleton.description: Animate Dead: Skeleton is a level 3 necromancy spell. This spell allows spellcasters to animate a corpse to create a Skeleton that focuses on ranged weaponry. They must target a corpse, and the skeleton lasts until killed or until the next long rest.

Animate Dead: Skeleton Squad.description: Animate Dead: Skeleton Squad is a level 4 necromancy spell. This spell is a higher level version of Animate Dead: Skeleton that can summon 3 Skeletons instead of 1. Accordingly, the user must also target 3 corpses for this instead of 1.

Animate Dead: Zombie.description: Animate Dead: Zombie is a level 3 necromancy spell. This spell allows spellcasters to animate a corpse to create a Zombie that specializes in melee combat. They must target a corpse, and the zombie lasts until killed or the next long rest.

Animate Dead: Zombie Batallion.description: Animate Dead: Zombie Battalion is a level 4 necromancy spell. This spell is a higher level version of Animate Dead: Zombie that can summon 3 Zombies instead of 1. Accordingly, the user must also target 3 corpses for this instead of 1.

Arabella's Shadow Entangle.description: Arabella's Shadow Entangle is a level 1 conjuration spell. It allows a character to entangle Undead and shadow creatures.

Banishing Smite (Melee).description: Banishing Smite (Melee) is a level 5 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to imbue their weapon with power, dealing force damage and possibly Banishing the target.

Banishing Smite (Ranged).description: Banishing Smite (Ranged) is a level 5 abjuration spell. This spells allows spellcasters to imbue their weapon with power, dealing force damage and possibly Banishing the target.

Bestow Curse: Additional Damage.description: Bestow Curse: Additional Damage is a level 3 necromancy spell. This spell allows spellcasters to curse a target, causing it to take additional damage from the caster's attacks and spells.

Bestow Curse: Attack Disadvantage.description: Bestow Curse: Attack Disadvantage is a level 3 necromancy spell. This spell allows spellcasters to curse a target, causing their attacks against the caster to have Disadvantage.

Bestow Curse: Charisma Disadvantage.description: Bestow Curse: Charisma Disadvantage is a level 3 necromancy spell. This spell allows spellcasters to curse a target, causing it to suffer Disadvantage on Charisma Checks and Saving Throws.

Bestow Curse: Constitution Disadvantage.description: Bestow Curse: Constitution Disadvantage is a level 3 necromancy spell. This spell allows spellcasters to curse a target, causing it to suffer Disadvantage on Constitution Checks and Saving Throws.

Bestow Curse: Dexterity Disadvantage.description: Bestow Curse: Dexterity Disadvantage is a level 3 necromancy spell. This spell allows spellcasters to curse a target, causing it to suffer Disadvantage on Dexterity Checks and Saving Throws.

Bestow Curse: Dread.description: Bestow Curse: Dread is a level 3 necromancy spell. This spell allows spellcasters to curse a target with dread, causing them to possibly skip their turn.

Bestow Curse: Intelligence Disadvantage.description: Bestow Curse: Intelligence Disadvantage is a level 3 necromancy spell. This spell allows spellcasters to curse a target, causing it to suffer Disadvantage on Intelligence Checks and Saving Throws.

Bestow Curse: Strength Disadvantage.description: Bestow Curse: Strength Disadvantage is a level 3 necromancy spell. This spell allows spellcasters to curse a target, causing it to suffer Disadvantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws.

Bestow Curse: Wisdom Disadvantage.description: Bestow Curse: Wisdom Disadvantage is a level 3 necromancy spell. This spell allows spellcasters to curse a target, causing it to suffer Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks and Saving Throws.

Branding Smite (Melee).description: Branding Smite (Melee) is a level 2 evocation spell. This spell is a variant of Branding Smite. It allows spellcasters to cause their melee weapon to gleam with astral radiance, allow them to mark targets with light, preventing them from turning Invisible

Branding Smite (Ranged).description: Branding Smite (Ranged) is a level 2 evocation spell. This spell is a variant of Branding Smite. It allows spellcasters to cause their ranged weapon to gleam with astral radiance, allow them to mark targets with light, preventing them from turning Invisible

Chromatic Orb: Acid.description: Chromatic Orb: Acid is a level 1 evocation spell. This spell is a variant of Chromatic Orb. It allows spellcasters to hurl a globe of acid, dealing Acid damage and creating an Acid Surface.

Chromatic Orb: Cold.description: Chromatic Orb: Cold is a level 1 evocation spell. This spell is a variant of Chromatic Orb. It allows spellcasters to hurl a globe of cold energy, dealing Cold damage and creating an Ice Surface.

Chromatic Orb: Fire.description: Chromatic Orb: Fire is a level 1 evocation spell. This spell is a variant of Chromatic Orb. It allows spellcasters to hurl a ball of fire, dealing Fire damage and creating a Fire Surface.

Chromatic Orb: Lightning.description: Chromatic Orb: Lightning is a level 1 evocation spell. This spell is a variant of Chromatic Orb. It allows spellcasters to hurl a ball of electricity, dealing Lightning damage and creating an Electrified Surface.

Chromatic Orb: Poison.description: Chromatic Orb: Poison is a level 1 evocation spell. This spell is a variant of Chromatic Orb. It allows spellcasters to hurl an orb of poison, dealing Poison damage and creating a Poison Surface.

Chromatic Orb: Thunder.description: Chromatic Orb: Thunder is a level 1 evocation spell. This spell is a variant of Chromatic Orb. It allows spellcasters to hurl a ball of thunder, dealing Thunder damage.

Command: Approach.description: Command: Approach is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell is a variant of Command. It allows spellcasters to order their target to temporarily approach and do nothing else.

Command: Approach (Undead).description: Command: Approach is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell is a variant of Exhort the Risen and is similar to the spell Command: Halt except it affects Undead only. It allows spellcasters to order their undead target to approach you and do nothing.

Command: Drop.description: Command: Drop is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell is a variant of Command. It allows spellcasters to order their target to drop their weapon and do nothing else.

Command: Drop (Undead).description: Command: Drop is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell is a variant of Exhort the Risen and is similar to the spell Command: Drop except it applies to Undead only. It allows spellcasters to order their Undead target drop their weapon

Command: Flee.description: Command: Flee is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell is a variant of Command. It allows spellcasters to order their target to temporarily flee and do nothing else.

Command: Flee (Undead).description: Command: Flee is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell is a variant of Exhort the Risen and is similar to the spell Command: Flee except it applies to Undead only. It allows spellcasters to order their Undead target to flee from you.

Command: Grovel.description: Command: Grovel is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to order their target to temporarily fall Prone and do nothing else.

Command: Grovel (Undead).description: Command: Grovel is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell is a variant of Exhort the Risen and is similar to the spell Command: Grovel except it applies to Undead only. It allows spellcasters to order their Undead target to fall Prone and do nothing.

Command: Halt.description: Command: Halt is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell is a variant of Command. It allows spellcasters to order their target temporarily from moving or taking Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions.

Command: Halt (Undead).description: Command: Halt is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell is a variant of Exhort the Risen and is similar to the spell Command: Halt except it applies to Undead only. It allows spellcasters to order their Undead target to halt in its tracks.

Conjure Barrage: Melee Weapon.description: Conjure Barrage: Melee Weapon is a level 3 conjuration spell. This spell allows rangers to use their melee weapon to strike everyone within a wide cone with a barrage of magical blades. This spell is a variant of Conjure Barrage.

Conjure Barrage: Ranged Weapon.description: Conjure Barrage: Ranged Weapon is a level 3 conjuration spell. This spell allows rangers to use their ranged weapon to strike everyone within a wide cone with a barrage of magical blades. This spell is a variant of Conjure Barrage.

Conjure Elemental: Air Elemental.description: Conjure Elemental: Air Elemental is a level 5 conjuration spell. This spell is a variant of Conjure Elemental that allows spellcasters to summon an Air Elemental.

Conjure Elemental: Air Myrmidon.description: Conjure Elemental: Air Myrmidon is a level 6 conjuration spell. This spell is a variant of Conjure Elemental that allows spellcasters to summon an Air Myrmidon.

Conjure Minor Elemental: Azer.description: Conjure Minor Elemental: Azer is a level 4 conjuration spell. It is a variant of Conjure Minor Elemental that summons an Azer.

Conjure Minor Elemental: Ice Mephits.description: Conjure Minor Elemental: Ice Mephits is a level 4 conjuration spell. It is a variant of Conjure Minor Elemental that summons two Ice Mephits.

Conjure Minor Elemental: Mud Mephits.description: Conjure Minor Elemental: Mud Mephits is a level 4 conjuration spell. It is a variant of Conjure Minor Elemental that summons two Mud Mephits.

Contagion: Blinding Sickness.description: Contagion: Blinding Sickness is a level 5 necromancy spell. This spell is a variation of the Level 5 Necromancy Spell, Contagion. It allows spellcasters to Poison an enemy, with the possibility of the affliction progressing into a Disease which saps target's Wisdom.

Curriculum of Strategy: Artistry of War.description: Curriculum of Strategy: Artistry of War is a level 5 evocation spell. Daylight: Sphere.description: Daylight: Sphere is a level 3 evocation spell. This spell is a variant of the spell Daylight This variant allows spellcasters to dispel darkness by summoning a sphere of light.

Dirty Trick: Vicious Mockery.description: Dirty Trick: Vicious Mockery is a cantrip (Enchantment). It is only available to Swashbuckler rogues.

Dispel Evil And Good: Break Enchantment.description: Dispel Evil And Good: Break Enchantment is a level 5 abjuration spell. This is only available after casting Dispel Evil and Good on yourself. This spell allows spellcasters to break enchantments cast on allies from otherworldly creatures.

Dispel Evil and Good.description: Dispel Evil And Good is a level 5 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to protect themselves from Evil and Good creatures, and allows them to break Enchantments on allies.

Dispel Magic.description: Dispel Magic is a level 3 abjuration spell. This spell allows spellcasters to dispel magic cast upon a character or object.

Divination.description: Divination is a school of magic. Divination magic tends to involve divination and insight. Very few Divination spells exist in Baldur's Gate 3, and fewer still can be learned by the player.

Draconic Elemental Weapon: Acid.description: Draconic Elemental Weapon: Acid is a level 3 transmutation spell. This spell is a variant of Draconic Elemental Weapon and imbues a weapon with corrosive might, granting it bonus Acid damage and a +1 to attack rolls.

Draconic Elemental Weapon: Cold.description: Draconic Elemental Weapon: Cold is a level 3 transmutation spell. This spell is a variant of Draconic Elemental Weapon and imbues a weapon with icy might, granting it bonus Cold damage and a +1 bonus to attack rolls.

Draconic Elemental Weapon: Fire.description: Draconic Elemental Weapon: Fire is a level 3 transmutation spell. This spell is a variant of Draconic Elemental Weapon and imbues a weapon with icy might, granting it bonus Fire damage and a +1 bonus to attack rolls.
