Elemental Weapon: Thunder.description: Elemental Weapon: Thunder is a level 3 transmutation spell. This spell is a variant of Elemental Weapon and imbues a weapon with thunderous might, granting it bonus Thunder damage and a +1 bonus to attack rolls.

Ensnaring Strike (Melee).description: Ensnaring Strike (Melee) is a level 1 conjuration spell. This spell allows spellcasters to use melee weapon attacks to ensnare enemies with thorny vines and deal Piercing damage to them each turn.

Ensnaring Strike (Ranged).description: Ensnaring Strike (Ranged) is a level 1 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to use ranged weapon attacks to ensnare enemies with thorny vines and deal Piercing damage to them each turn.

Entangle (Wood Woad).description: Entangle is a level 1 conjuration spell. It is a variant of Entangle available to wood woads. Compared to the standard spell, it has a significantly shorter range, but larger area of effect.

Ethel's Insect Plague.description: Ethel's Insect Plague is a level 5 conjuration spell. This spell allows Auntie Ethel to create a damaging, debilitating swarm of insects over a section of the battlefield. It cannot be learned by party members.

Eyebite: Asleep.description: Eyebite: Asleep is a level 6 necromancy spell. It allows the caster to repeatedly force enemies asleep.

Eyebite: Panicked.description: Eyebite: Panicked is a level 6 necromancy spell. It allows the caster to scare enemies for up to 10 turns.

Eyebite: Sickened.description: Eyebite: Sickened is a level 6 necromancy spell. It makes a target deathly sick every turn.

Eyes of the Dark: Darkness.description: Eyes of the Dark: Darkness is a level 2 evocation spell. It creates a dark cloud that heavily obscures and blinds all creatures inside.

Find Familiar: Cat.description: Find Familiar: Cat is a level 1 conjuration spell. This spell is a variation of the spell Find Familiar that summons a small cat to the caster's side.

Find Familiar: Crab.description: Find Familiar: Crab is a level 1 conjuration spell. This spell is a variant of the spell Find Familiar that summons a small crab.

Find Familiar: Frog.description: Find Familiar: Frog is a level 1 conjuration spell. This spell is a variant of the spell Find Familiar that summons a small frog.

Find Familiar: Imp.description: Find Familiar: Imp is a level 1 conjuration spell. This spell is a variant of the spell Find Familiar that summons a small imp.

Find Familiar: Quasit.description: Find Familiar: Quasit is a level 1 conjuration spell. This spell is a variant of the spell Find Familiar that summons a small quasit.

Find Familiar: Rat.description: Find Familiar: Rat is a level 1 conjuration spell. This spell is a variant of the spell Find Familiar that summons a small rat.

Find Familiar: Raven.description: Find Familiar: Raven is a level 1 conjuration spell. This spell is a variant of the spell Find Familiar that summons a small raven.

Find Familiar: Scratch.description: Find Familiar: Scratch is a level 1 conjuration spell. This spell is a special version of Find Familiar that summons the dog named Scratch. Cannot be used within the campsite.

Find Familiar: Spider.description: Find Familiar: Spider is a level 1 conjuration spell. This spell is a variant of the spell Find Familiar that summons a small spider.

Fire Shield: Chill.description: Fire Shield: Chill is a level 4 evocation spell. This spell shields the spellcaster with ice-cold flames. It is a variant of Fire Shield.

Fire Shield: Warm.description: Fire Shield: Warm is a level 4 evocation spell. This spell shields the spellcaster with scorching flames. It is a variant of Fire Shield

Fly (bonus action).description: Fly is a level 3 transmutation spell. This bonus action allows you fly through the air using your movement speed.

Formsculpt: Tressym.description: Formsculpt Tressym is a level 9 transmutation spell. It transforms a creature into a ⁠Tressym.

Githborn: Flying Boots.description: Githborn: Flying Boots is a level 3 transmutation spell. Bestow the ability to Fly upon yourself.

Glyph of Warding: Acid.description: Glyph of Warding: Acid is a level 3 abjuration spell. This spell is a variant of the Level 3 Abjuration Spell, Glyph of Warding. It allows spellcasters to inscribe a ward which explodes and deals Acid damage to enemies when triggered.

Glyph of Warding: Cold.description: Glyph of Warding: Cold is a level 3 abjuration spell. This spell is a variant of the Level 3 Abjuration Spell, Glyph of Warding. It allows spellcasters to inscribe a ward which explodes and deals Cold damage to enemies when triggered.

Glyph of Warding: Detonation.description: Glyph of Warding: Detonation is a level 3 abjuration spell. This spell is a variant of the Level 3 Abjuration Spell, Glyph of Warding. It allows spellcasters to inscribe a ward which explodes and pushes every creature back when triggered.

Glyph of Warding: Fire.description: Glyph of Warding: Fire is a level 3 abjuration spell. This spell is a variant of the Level 3 Abjuration Spell, Glyph of Warding. It allows spellcasters to inscribe a ward which explodes and deals Fire damage to enemies when triggered.

This variant of the spell allows spellcasters to inscribe a ward that explodes and deals Lightning damage to enemies when triggered.

Glyph of Warding: Sleep.description: Glyph of Warding: Sleep is a level 3 abjuration spell. This spell is a variant of the Level 3 Abjuration Spell, Glyph of Warding. It allows spellcasters to inscribe a ward which can put enemies to Sleep when triggered.

Glyph of Warding: Thunder.description: Glyph of Warding: Thunder is a level 3 abjuration spell. This spell is a variant of the Level 3 Abjuration Spell, Glyph of Warding. It allows spellcasters to inscribe a ward which explodes and deals Thunder damage to enemies when triggered.

Heat Metal: Reapply Damage.description: Reapply Heat Metal is a level 2 transmutation spell. This spell allows spellcasters to re-heat up a metal weapon or armour on the targeted creature, forcing them to let go or receive damage or suffer various penalties.

Hex (Charisma).description: Hex (Charisma) is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell allows spellcasters to put a curse on a creature and deal additional Necrotic damage to them. The curse also imposes Disadvantage on the creature's Charisma checks.

Hex (Constitution).description: Hex (Constitution) is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell allows spellcasters to put a curse on a creature and deal additional Necrotic damage to them. The curse also imposes Disadvantage on the creature's Constitution checks.

Hex (Dexterity).description: Hex (Dexterity) is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell allows spellcasters to put a curse on a creature and deal additional Necrotic damage to them. The curse also imposes Disadvantage on the creature's Dexterity checks.

Hex (Intelligence).description: Hex (Intelligence) is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell allows spellcasters to put a curse on a creature and deal additional Necrotic damage to them. The curse also imposes Disadvantage on the creature's Intelligence checks.

Hex (Strength).description: Hex (Strength) is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell allows spellcasters to put a curse on a creature and deal additional Necrotic damage to them. The curse also imposes Disadvantage on the creature's Strength checks.

Hex (Wisdom).description: Hex (Wisdom) is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell allows spellcasters to put a curse on a creature and deal additional Necrotic damage to them. The curse also imposes Disadvantage on the creature's Wisdom checks.

Jump.description: Jump is a common Bonus Action that allows characters to jump vertically or horizontally, up to a distance determined by their Strength score.

Khalid's Gift: Aid.description: Khalid's Gift: Aid is a level 3 abjuration spell. It allows the wearer of Khalid's Gift to cast a version of Aid to increase their hit points by 10.

Legacy of Avernus: Searing Smite.description: Legacy of Avernus: Searing Smite is a level 1 evocation spell. This is a unique variant of Searing Smite available to Zariel Tieflings starting at level 3.

Levitate.description: Levitate is a movement action and illithid power available to Full-Illithids and other mind flayers. It allows them to fly to distant location with a small, fixed movement cost.

Mapped Terror: Betrayal.description: Mapped Terror: Betrayal is a level 4 illusion spell. This spell dominates a target and then frightens their ally with the inexorable terror of betrayal. It cannot be learned by party members.

Mapped Terror: Ceremorphosis.description: Mapped Terror: Ceremorphosis is a level 4 illusion spell. This spell creates the illusion that its target has transformed into a Mind Flayer, freezing them in fear. It cannot be learned by party members.

Mapped Terror: Darkness.description: This spell frightens a target with the inexorable terror of darkness, inflicting a vicious blinding disease upon them. Exploit the target's mapped fear to Frighten it and inflict Blinding Sickness upon it.

Mapped Terror: Disease.description: Mapped Terror: Disease is a level 4 illusion spell. This spell frightens a target with the inexorable terror of disease, inflicting a vicious rotting disease upon them. It cannot be learned by party members.

Mapped Terror: Powerlessness.description: Mapped Terror: Powerlessness is a level 4 illusion spell. This spell frightens a target with the inexorable terror of darkness, draining them of physical strength. It cannot be learned by party members.

Mapped Terror: Spiders.description: Mapped Terror: Spiders is a level 6 illusion spell. This spell terrifies its target by transforming Viconia DeVir and two of her allies into vicious spiders. It cannot be learned by party members.

Mapped Terror: Wolves.description: Mapped Terror: Wolves is a level 6 illusion spell. This spell transforms Viconia DeVir and two nearby Sharran Novices into vicious wolves. Viconia uses this action if she performs the Mapping of the Heart on Shadowheart. It cannot be learned by party members.

Mystic Carrion's Vile Curse.description: Mystic Carrion's Vile Curse is a level 6 necromancy spell. This spell allows the user to curse a foe. It cannot be learned by party members.

Otiluke's Freezing Sphere (Launch).description: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere is a level 6 evocation spell.

Planar Ally: Cambion.description: Planar Ally: Cambion is a level 6 conjuration spell. This spell is a variant of the Level 6 Conjuration Spell, Planar Ally. It allows spellcasters to summon a Fiend for aid.

Planar Ally: Deva.description: Planar Ally: Deva is a level 6 conjuration spell. This spell is a variant of the Level 6 Conjuration Spell, Planar Ally. It allows spellcasters to summon a Celestial for aid.

Planar Ally: Djinni.description: Planar Ally: Djinni is a level 6 conjuration spell. This spell is a variant of the Level 6 Conjuration Spell, Planar Ally. It allows spellcasters to summon an Elemental for aid.

Power Word: Ruin.description: Power Word: Ruin is a level 9 transmutation spell. It causes significant destruction with three magical beams.

Produce Flame: Dismiss.description: Produce Flame: Dismiss is a cantrip (Conjuration). Douses the flames in your hand, created after first casting Produce Flame.

Produce Flame: Hurl.description: Produce Flame: Hurl is a cantrip (Conjuration). It throws the flame you conjured in your hand by Produce Flame at a target.

Protection from Energy: Acid.description: Protection from Energy: Acid is a level 3 abjuration spell. This spell allows spellcasters to grant a creature they touch Resistance to Acid damage.

Protection from Energy: Cold.description: Protection from Energy: Cold is a level 3 abjuration spell. This spell allows spellcasters to grant a creature they touch Resistance to Cold damage.

Protection from Energy: Fire.description: Protection from Energy: Fire is a level 3 abjuration spell. This spell allows spellcasters to grant a creature they touch Resistance to Fire damage.

Protection from Energy: Lightning.description: Protection from Energy: Lightning is a level 3 abjuration spell. This spell allows spellcasters to grant a creature they touch Resistance to Lightning damage.

Protection from Energy: Thunder.description: Protection from Energy: Thunder is a level 3 abjuration spell. This spell allows spellcasters to grant a creature they touch Resistance to Thunder damage.

Psionic Suggestion: Drop.description: Psionic Suggestion: Drop is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell allows spellcasters to order their target to flee, move closer, freeze, drop to the ground, drop their weapon, or be silenced. It cannot be learned by party members.

Psionic Suggestion: Flee.description: Psionic Suggestion: Flee is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell allows spellcasters to order their target to temporarily flee and do nothing else. It cannot be learned by party members.

Psionic Suggestion: Grovel.description: Psionic Suggestion: Grovel is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to order their target to temporarily fall Prone and do nothing else. It cannot be learned by party members.

Psionic Suggestion: Halt.description: Psionic Suggestion: Halt is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell allows spellcasters to order their target to temporarily fall Prone and do nothing else. It cannot be learned by party members.

Psionic Suggestion: Hush.description: Psionic Suggestion: Hush is a level 1 enchantment spell. This spell allows spellcasters to silence their target temporarily, preventing them from casting spells with a verbal component. It cannot be learned by party members.

Rolan's Colour Spray.description: Rolan's Colour Spray is a level 1 illusion spell. This spell is a variant of the Colour Spray spell, unique to Rolan. It cannot be learned by party members.

Rolan's Mage Armour.description: Rolan's Mage Armour is a level 1 abjuration spell. This spell is a variant of the Mage Armour spell, unique to Rolan. It cannot be learned by party members.

Rolan's Magic Missile.description: Rolan's Magic Missile is a level 1 evocation spell. This spell is a variant of the Magic Missile spell, unique to Rolan. It cannot be learned by party members.

Rolan's Thunderwave.description: Rolan's Thunderwave is a level 1 evocation spell. This spell is a variant of the Thunderwave spell, unique to Rolan. It cannot be learned by party members.

Searing Smite (Azer).description: Searing Smite is a level 1 evocation spell. It is a unique version of Searing Smite available to azers. Compared with the normal version, it does not consume a Bonus Action on hit, has a once-per-combat restriction, does not cost spell slots, and of course cannot be upcasted for extra damage. It cannot be learned by party members.

Sethan: Reduce.description:
Sethan: Reduce is a level 2 transmutation spell. This spell allows users to decrease a creature's body size. Affected creatures deal less damage with their weapons and have Disadvantage on Strength Ability Checks and Saving Throws.
This item spell is a variant of Reduce.

Sethan: Spiritual Greataxe.description:
Sethan: Spiritual Greataxe is a level 6 evocation spell. This is a unique item spell allows the wielder of Sethan to summon an ethereal greataxe that can attack enemies.
This is equivalent to the Cleric spell Spiritual Weapon: Greataxe cast at level 6.

Shar's Aegis.description: Shar's Aegis is a level 1 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to surround themselves with ⁠Shar's protection and gain a bonus to their Armour Class, reduce incoming damage and apply ⁠Necrotic damage to all attackers.[See: Bugs]

Shar's Darkness.description: Shar's Darkness is a level 2 evocation spell. It creates a dark cloud that heavily obscures and blinds all creatures inside.

Shield of Devotion: Aid.description: Shield of Devotion: Aid is a level 3 abjuration spell. This spell is a variant of Aid and allows Shield of Devotion's wearer to heal themselves for 10⁠⁠Hit Points and increase their hit points for the same amount.

Sights of the Seelie: Summon Deva.description: Sights of the Seelie: Summon Deva is a level 6 conjuration spell. It summons a Deva under the control of the caster. This spell is functionally identical to Planar Ally: Deva and does not stack with it.

Spirit Guardians (Necrotic).description: Spirit Guardians: Necrotic is a level 3 conjuration spell. This spell is a variation of the spell Spirit Guardians. This variant deals ⁠Necrotic damage as well as slows the Movement of nearby enemies.

Spirit Guardians (Radiant).description: Spirit Guardians: Radiant is a level 3 conjuration spell. This spell is a variation of the spell Spirit Guardians. This variant deals ⁠Radiant damage as well as slows the Movement of nearby enemies.

Spiritual Weapon: Greataxe.description: Spiritual Weapon: Greataxe is a level 2 evocation spell. This spell is a variant of the Level 2 Evocation Spell, Spiritual Weapon. It allows spellcasters to summon a floating Greataxe that can attack enemies.

Spiritual Weapon: Greatsword.description: Spiritual Weapon: Greatsword is a level 2 evocation spell. This spell is a variant of the Level 2 Evocation Spell, Spiritual Weapon. It allows spellcasters to summon a floating Greatsword that can attack enemies.

Spiritual Weapon: Halberd.description: Spiritual Weapon: Halberd is a level 2 evocation spell. This spell is a variant of the Level 2 Evocation Spell, Spiritual Weapon. It allows spellcasters to summon a floating Halberd that can attack enemies.

Spiritual Weapon: Maul.description: Spiritual Weapon: Maul is a level 2 evocation spell. This spell is a variant of the Level 2 Evocation Spell, Spiritual Weapon. It allows spellcasters to summon a floating Maul that can attack enemies.

Spiritual Weapon: Spear.description: Spiritual Weapon: Spear is a level 2 evocation spell. This spell is a variant of the Level 2 Evocation Spell, Spiritual Weapon. It allows spellcasters to summon a floating Spear that can attack enemies.

Spiritual Weapon: Trident.description: Spiritual Weapon: Trident is a level 2 evocation spell. This spell is a variant of the Level 2 Evocation Spell, Spiritual Weapon. It allows spellcasters to summon a floating Trident that can attack enemies.

Star Map: Guiding Bolt.description: Star Map: Guiding Bolt is a level 1 evocation spell. This spell exclusive to the Circle of the Stars druid, allows spellcasters to hit enemies with radiant bolt that deals ⁠Radiant damage and grants advantage to attack rolls made against them.

Vicious Mockery (Auntie Ethel).description: Vicious Mockery is a cantrip (Enchantment). A stronger variant of Vicious Mockery, boasting increased damage and range, and costing a bonus action. It cannot be learned by party members.

Vicious Mockery (Milil).description: Vicious Mockery is a cantrip (Enchantment). It is a significantly stronger variant of Vicious Mockery, boasting increased damage and range as well as knocking the target back 10 m (33 ft). It cannot be learned by party members.

Acid Breath.description: Acid Breath is a Dragonborn racial action. This ability allows them to breathe a column of damaging acid in a target direction.

Lightning Breath.description: Lightning Breath is a Dragonborn racial action. This ability allows them to breathe a column of damaging lightning in a target direction.

Poison Breath.description: Poison Breath is a Dragonborn racial action. This ability allows them to breathe a cone of poisonous breath in a target direction.

Frost Breath.description: Frost Breath is a Dragonborn racial action. This ability allows them to breathe a cone of damaging cold energy in a target direction.

Dispel Evil And Good.description: Dispel Evil And Good is a level 5 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to protect themselves from Evil and Good creatures, and allows them to break Enchantments on allies.
